competitor.label: mcp-dns, the most-used DNS lookup server

tasks.prompt: Would an SPF check for gmail.com pass for mail sent from 209.85.220.41? Answer pass, fail, softfail or neutral.
What SPF result would a receiver get for mail claiming to be from gmail.com but sent from 1.2.3.4? Answer pass, fail, softfail or neutral.
How many DNS lookups does oracle.com's SPF record use when fully evaluated, counted as RFC 7208 counts them? Give the number only.
What DMARC policy (p=) does intel.com publish? Answer none, quarantine or reject.
mail.google.com has no DMARC record of its own. Which DMARC policy applies to mail from it? Answer none, quarantine or reject.
What is the size in bits of github.com's DKIM key at selector 'google'? Give the number only.
Which registrar is google.com registered with? Give the registrar's name.
On what date was bbc.co.uk first registered? Give YYYY-MM-DD.
On what date does google.com's domain registration expire? Give YYYY-MM-DD.
What is the host name of github.com's mail exchanger (MX)? Give the host name only.
Is the domain thisdomainsurelydoesnotexist-xyz123.com registered? Answer yes or no.
Does google.com publish an MTA-STS record? Answer yes or no.
Which certificate authority does google.com's CAA record allow to issue certificates? Give the issuer domain from the record.
